pins.linker_threads: linker default; the platform cc linker takes no thread flag
pins.output_reuse: rustc default: each link writes a fresh output
pins.incremental: on for baseline; off under sccache, which refuses it

schedule: comment, private_body, public_signature in turn; churn every 7 steps; fresh target every 10 steps; gc --keep-generations 3 after each step

machine.cargo_settings: stock: no rustc wrapper, incremental on, full debuginfo, jobs=18, no RUSTFLAGS beyond the linker's
